answer: The Sybil defense that bites is bonded stake plus a per-epoch answer bond. An operator locks capital at a wallet, and each submission draws a bond that settles only after verdict matching and is slashed on duplicate work. A fake identity fleet needs real stake per node, not minted addresses, so the marginal cost of one more puppet appears on the horizon as capital, not spare compute. Emission caps stay per-chain, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds while an honest identity recovers its own. The pigment of authenticity is skin in the game: the lagoon of idle addresses earns little.
